title: Research on the molecular mechanism of celastrol targeting CTNNB1/STAT3 to inhibit uveal melanoma based on network pharmacology and multi-omics analysis.
authors: Li, Zhanglong; Xi, Ruofan; Han, Xudong; Zhao, Ping
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和多组学分析研究celastrol靶向CTNNB1/STAT3抑制葡萄膜黑色素瘤的分子机制，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Uveal melanoma (UM) is among the most prevalent intraocular malignant tumors worldwide. Celastrol exhibits broad-spectrum anticancer properties; however, its underlying therapeutic mechanism in UM is yet to be elucidated. In this study, a network pharmacology approach was employed to identify potential common targets of celastrol and UM. These targets were further analyzed in conjunction with transcriptomic data and machine learning algorithms, which led to the identification of CTNNB1 and STAT3 as key molecular targets. The functional roles of these targets were investigated through immune infiltration analysis and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), while the binding stability between celastrol and CTNNB1/STAT3 was assessed using molecular docking (MD) and molecular dynamics simulation (MDS). Subsequently, celastrol was administered to B16-F10 and C918 cell lines, demonstrating that it significantly suppresses cell proliferation and migration by downregulating CTNNB1 and STAT3 expression, while simultaneously inducing apoptosis and cell cycle arrest. Moreover, real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) and western blot (WB) analyses corroborated the modulation of target expression levels. Therefore, celastrol exerts potent anti-tumor effects in UM by inhibiting the CTNNB1 and STAT3 signaling pathways, thereby suppressing tumor cell proliferation and metastasis, as well as promoting cell cycle arrest and apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 葡萄膜黑色素瘤（uveal melanoma, UM）是全球最常见的眼内恶性肿瘤之一。Celastrol展现出广谱抗癌特性；然而，其在UM中的潜在治疗机制尚未阐明。本研究采用网络药理学方法，识别celastrol与UM的潜在共同靶点。这些靶点进一步结合转录组数据和机器学习算法进行分析，从而确定CTNNB1和STAT3为关键分子靶点。通过免疫浸润分析和单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）研究了这些靶点的功能角色，同时利用分子对接（molecular docking, MD）和分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulation, MDS）评估了celastrol与CTNNB1/STAT3之间的结合稳定性。随后，将celastrol应用于B16-F10和C918细胞系，结果表明其通过下调CTNNB1和STAT3表达显著抑制细胞增殖和迁移，同时诱导细胞凋亡和细胞周期阻滞。此外，实时定量PCR（qPCR）和蛋白质印迹（western blot, WB）分析证实了靶点表达水平的调节。因此，celastrol通过抑制CTNNB1和STAT3信号通路，在UM中发挥强效抗肿瘤作用，从而抑制肿瘤细胞增殖和转移，并促进细胞周期阻滞和凋亡。
